summary: Verified two frontend-only changes to program-mode Today screen: (1) Hero mode removed — Primary/main-lift exercise (Boxing, User A) now renders ALL sets simultaneously in the standard all-sets card. Confirmed set-1 log completes and the row remains visible with the logged value (reps=15). An 'Edit logged' chip is available to re-edit completed set values. Sets 2,3,4 remain visible throughout. (2) Up/down (↑/↓) arrows removed from program-mode ExerciseCard header. DOM scan of the Boxing PRIMARY card and all warm-up/support/accessory cards found NO arrow-up (mdi F005D) or arrow-down (mdi F0045) glyphs — only chevron-up/chevron-down (F0143/F0140) for the expand toggle, and the ⋮ dots-vertical kebab (F01D9) plus a drag handle icon in the header. Kebab menu opens correctly and shows a REORDER section with 'Move Up' (disabled for first primary) and 'Move Down' (enabled) items — reorder path preserved. Code review confirms: all program-mode ExerciseCard call sites (lines 5859, 5952, 6031, 6095 in today.tsx) pass BOTH onKebab and dragHandle, so the arrow branch (line 2500: `!dragHandle && !onKebab`) is unreachable in program mode. Tracker-mode call site (line 5541) passes `onKebab={undefined}` and no dragHandle → arrows correctly still render there. No React Native / deprecated-package regressions introduced by this change.

Standard all-sets rendering path (today.tsx:2583+) is now taken for Primary/Speed as well — hero single-set branch removed as intended.
